clarified_intent.description: Independently audit the Dart/Riverpod library implementation and archive evidence without promoting the full Flutter application or wider 3.0 release.

constraints: Every phase-plan acceptance claim must have direct deterministic evidence.
The official Flutter stable floor and zero-warning clean package candidate must remain reproducible.
BDD must fail before and pass after the final archive manifest exists.
Visual evidence must stay limited to the inspected host widget harness.
Public ledgers, coverage, docs, skills, research, and downstream limits must agree.
Archive readiness must not authorize Pub.dev publication or full-release certification.

target_state.description: A reproducible bounded library archive with zero unsupported application, device, registry, or full-release claims.
success_criteria: Stable Dart/Melos and package-candidate gates pass
Permanent Node, Flutter, and BDD proof passes
Every public and evidence ledger is synchronized
Original-resolution visual receipts remain hash-bound and scoped
Every unresolved lane has a downstream owner
Publication remains unauthorized and fullReleaseCertified remains false
